panels.html:
Olga Review

Pros

  • Buffs DoT Team's DPS quite significantly, with Shattering.

  • Able to Activate Fracture, Agony, and Scorched many times in one turn.

  • Able to buff a lot via Neutral and Divine epiphanies (Morale & -Fortitude, respectively).

Cons

  • Much of Olga’s supportive utility is locked behind Premium upgrades, mainly her E2’s healing and Partner’s ally DoT Buff.

  • Olga can be quite expensive (both Draw and AP).

Review

Introduction

Olga’s play-style revolves around inflicting Fracture and Agony on their enemies and increasing DoT damage via Shattering. Fracture and Agony both deal their damage at the end of the turn by default, Olga is able to bypass this and activate Fracture and Agony instantly through their Rift of Severance and Dispersed Desire cards. Olga is able to also Move these cards back to their hand when Fracture or Agony are activated while she has a stack of Brand of Agony/Fracture, allowing her to continue her assault.

Shattering essentially acts as a true multiplier to all DoT damage, as it can be played every 2-turns and applies a 2-turn Effect which deals a substantial percentage of extra damage based on the DoT damage done as fixed, non-crittable damage. Making Olga a premiere support for any DoT damage based teams.

Review

Key Mechanics

  • Rapacity 

    • Rapacity is a buff that Olga gains each time Fracture or Agony is applied through an ability, stacking up to 30. Rapacity is consumed when Olga activates her Mythical Card, Reckoning - increasing the base damage by +20% for each stack of Rapacity held, resetting once Reckoning has been used.

  • Brand of Agony

    • Brand of Agony is a buff that Olga obtains from the base version of Break Apart & Renew and some of the available epiphanies. When Olga’s Agony is activated, Olga moves 1 copy of Rift of Severance to their hand, reduces its cost by 1 and removes 1 stack of Brand of Agony. This provides Olga an incredible source of self sufficient AP management and access to Rift of Severance to continue scaling Agony/Fracture.

  • Brand of Fracture

    • Brand of Fracture is a buff that Olga obtains from their Break Apart & Renew card once it has been transformed via some of the available epiphanies. Brand of Fracture activates when Olga’s Fracture is activated, moving Olga’s Dispersed Desire to their hand, reducing its cost by 1 until used and removing 1 stack of Brand of Fracture. Very similar to Brand of Agony, provides Olga self sufficient AP management and deck cycling for their Dispersed Desire card.

  • Shattering

    • Shattering is a debuff Olga applies via their End of the Line card. When a target inflicted with Shattering has a DoT effect activated, Shattering inflicts additional Fixed Damage to the target equal to 30% of the Damage Amount taken. At the end of the turn, Shattering reduces its stack amount by 1. Should be applied to enemies as soon as possible to maximize damage output.

Review

Preconstructed Decks

Decks not named in this section are generally not recommended to be bought. This does not mean they have no use ever or are not viable, but that our opinion is there are better uses for currency because they are too niche or easy to make with minimal save data editing tools. 

[Break Apart & Renew] - While Deck itself could use some further optimization, it does have an extremely rare divine already on it (Weakness Attack: -2 Fortitude). If you don't have the time to farm a rare Divine, it's worth considering getting this deck and then editing it to the intended build later (like the Olga: Buffer & Debuffer recommended Deck).

Synergies

Olga Synergies

Hugo
Draw DPS

Olga is able to buff a large amount and also play skills while doing so via Neutral Epiphanies and Divines (See Decks & Teams), with the most major drawback of her buffing being Draw and AP needs. Because Hugo teams often have High Draw and Low AP Costs, he is a premiere teammate for Olga.

  • Olga tends to play a fair amount of Skills while doing damage, which funnels Hugo's Commence the Hunt.
  • Olga is capable of buffing an extremely high amount, but needs Draw, which Hugo provides.
Hilde
Draw DPS

Similar to Hugo, Hilde is able to Draw a lot with relatively low AP costs (though, not zero) which covers Olga's major weakness as a buffer and benefits from her major strengths.

  • Hilde provides a large amount of Draw.
  • Hilde has high synergy with another strong synergy of Olga's, Hugo.
  • Hilde is capable of target-drawing Attack Cards, which can be useful for Olga's necessary setup.
Arabella
Fracture Support

Arabella is capable of applying Fracture Amplification which can help increase the minimum Fracture damage of Olga, as it applies extra Fracture when Olga activates it herself, and Olga is able to increase all Fracture damage via Shattering.

  • Fracture Amplification increases Olga's damage, for Olga DPS.
  • Olga can buff Arabella's Fracture Damage a significant amount via Shattering.
  • Both of them having decent Draw and AP needs which can limit their allies and make their team clunky to execute.
Veronica
Draw

When used in a Buffing role, Veronica is a standout synergy as she can cover Olga's weaknesses in AP and Draw areas which allows Olga to buff more easily uninhibited.

  • Veronica consolidating Draw and AP in one role matches Olga's ability to consolidate high buffing in one slot, very efficiently.
  • Olga struggles to hit Morale cap herself, as a Buffer, because of lower than normal Neutral access. Rosaria on Veronica is a great way to get closer to that cap.

CRIT RATE% = CRIT DMG% >= Unique Card DMG% > Common Card DMG% = Basic Card DMG%

Seasonal

Olga Seasonal Powers

Introduces Desire Cards. Desire Cards are cards that primarily exist to give a strong passive buff from meeting certain Desire Thresholds (3/5/7) which can only be done by having multiple ally decks also made in Season-4. 

  • For Desire Threshold, it’s common to run 1 Claim / 1 Survival / 1 Inquiry for use in a variety of builds; however, it's also common to just do 3 ‘X’ to meet effect easier or do 2 'X' / 1 Inquiry (to keep Sample Collection as Card Effect). This is extremely dependent on ally desire cards and individual team building goal.

  • For DPS Olga, it's recommended to do 5 Claim to increase her DoT damage. Though, this often raises AP requirements a lot.

’X’ refers to a ‘Placeholder for Specific Desire Threshold Goal’, i.e. if you are building your team for 7 Claim then you might do 2 Claim / 1 Inquiry.

Introduces Persona Cards and Engravings. Persona Cards are powerful cards that introduce new playstyles or ways of buffing/debuffing. Engravings are effects that can be applied to both the Persona Cards and Equipment, functioning near identically to Refinements of Season-2 but with new effects.

  • There is no recommended Card Engraving, often times it will be specific to the team or skipped entirely (focusing just on Equipment Engravings). 

  • The most common SUPPORT Equipment Engraving to optimize for is the stacking [When Action Count of enemies is increased by allies, +50% Damage Amount to Ally Attack Cards for 1 turn (1 time per turn)] and [When a card of this unit is activated, 30% to increase Action Count of all enemies by 1 (1 time per turn)], but it's possible to use a variety of other options for a specific set-up (like Discard [Quietus] Engravings when playing high [Quietus] builds or Umbra Engravings just to meet the threshold for certain Persona cards).

  • The most common DAMAGE Equipment Engraving to optimize for is [When 15 or more cards are in Graveyard, +15% Critical Damage to Attack Cards of this unit], but this effect does not stack, so other equipment Engravings that increase damage can also be used.

Introduces Refinements, effects on Equipment that allow one to get additional Equipment effects for no Faint-Cost (post-S2), and God’s Hammer, a powerful effect that gives a random copy of any other Equipment effect on-top of current Equipment but costs 10 Faint Memory and is only gained from the Boss.

  • Increase Damage Amount of Attack Cards by 20%.

  • +30% Damage Amount of 1-cost or lower Attack Cards.

+15% Critical Hit on Vulnerable, only works on Attack Cards, which makes it not synergistic with Olga's main damage of Fracture.

Because God’s Hammer is completely RNG at the end of the run, we do not have a specific recommendation since the player has very little control over the decision but for ATK-based Attackers usually ATK% gear is considered best and DEF-based Attackers DEF% gear is considered best.

Introduces Forbidden Cards, powerful cards that create new synergies and can only be acquired once per run (can be duped at one event or via save data editing). 

For Supportive Olga, it's recommended to do Season-1 for Guidance of Futility in order to allow her to be a fully fledged healer at E0, as many teams she is used as a buffer in lack a Healer w/o her E2. For DPS Olga, other seasons are preferred.

  • Forbidden: Gesture of Freedom. Permanent Cost-Reduction to 1-card, can be manipulated.

  • Forbidden: Eternal Hunger. +Draw, ++AP (Ally Reliant)

  • Forbidden: Portrait of Fury. ++Draw, +Damage

  • Forbidden: Guidance of Futility. +++Survivability

  • Forbidden: Ecstasy of Violence. +Damage

Dupes

Olga Dupes

DupePerformanceNotes
Base
—
Base performance of the character.
Ego 1
101.28%
Olga’s first Ego to be unlocked reduces the cost of their Mythic Card, End of the Line by 1. Additionally, increases the base damage dealt by Reckoning by an additional +200% and increases the additional base damage per Rapacity to 30%. This is a pretty solid first overall Ego, providing some solid AP alleviation while increasing the potential damage output of Reckoning by 50%.
Ego 2
106.54%
Olga’s second Ego increases the damage dealt by the Shattering debuff to 40% fixed damage, on top of this - whenever Fracture or Agony is activated, Olga recovers 4% of Max HP up to 5 times per turn. This is a pretty strong Ego to be unlocked, providing a very solid and consistent source of healing. The percentage increase is much more substantial when using her as a Buffer for Ally Fracture, as well.
Ego 3
106.74%
Olga’s Vivid Memory enhances their Ego Skill, increasing the damage dealt by an additional +200% and changes the max damage threshold for each Fracture, Agony and Scorch activated during this turn from 300% to 450%. Overall not super impactful and only provides some additional damage output to Olga.
Ego 4
109.86%
Olga’s fourth Ego grants Olga 1 stack of Shard Erosion each time Olga’s Fracture or Agony is activated. Shard Erosion is a buff that stacks up to 5 times and lasts indefinitely, increasing Olga’s DoT Damage by 6% per stack. This is a very nice Ego for Olga, there are currently very few buffs that directly increase DoT damage so anything helps.
Ego 5
110.27%
Olga’s Complete Memory is the standard Potential node increase for their Basic, Common and Signature cards. Overall not incredibly impactful but does provide a slight increase to the base damage values of their cards.
Ego 6
123.51%
Olga’s final Ego moves Olga’s End of the Line or Reckoning card to their hand at the start of each turn. It also increases the damage buff provided by Shard Erosion to 10% per stack, on top of this - once Olga reaches 5 stacks of Shard Erosion, grants Olga an additional +50% Critical Damage. This is an incredibly powerful Ego that improves consistency and really pushes Olga’s potential damage output.
